releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.26:
- Visual Quick Hardware Setup Guide: New interactive and printable 1-page visual guide accessible directly in-app at /hardware-guide and in pairing portal. Supports English and Spanish toggle, print-to-PDF, and 3-step setup walkthrough.
- Universal Hardware Setup (.bat): Unified 1-click station installer for all 10 hardware stations plus thermal printers and cash drawer background service.
- Smart TV / 4-Digit Code Screen Pairing: Zero configuration screen connection with glowing 4-digit code and 1-click approval popup on the Main Cash Register.
- Chatbot Updates: In-app virtual assistant responds instantly to hardware, manual, and setup guide inquiries.
- Zero Regressions: Passed automated integrity audit across all 72 modal dialogs with 0 errors.
